# Asset Credits

## Zelda-like tilesets and sprites — ArMM1998

- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/zelda-like-tilesets-and-sprites
- License: CC0 1.0 (public domain) — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Files: `source/Overworld.png`, `source/Inner.png`, `source/character.png`

The game atlases (`tiles.png`, `char-p1.png`, `char-p2.png`) are built from
these sheets by `scripts/build_assets.py` (tiles upscaled 2x, character
recoloured for player 2). The gem and the UI remain procedurally generated.
